## TRA Timeline

#### HotelPlanner.com merger announcement

- 2021-08-11: 8-K reports merger with Lexyl Travel Technologies, LLC (d/b/a HotelPlanner.com); form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.1 with blank preamble date
- 2022-01-28: Definitive merger proxy filed; form-of TRA incorporated by reference

#### Merger termination and SPAC wind-down

- 2022-02-13: Merger Agreement mutually terminated; TRA never executed
- 2022-12-22: Special meeting authorizes early SPAC termination and trust liquidation
- 2022-12-29: Form 25-NSE delisting filed; SPAC dissolves

## Explanation

Astrea Acquisition Corp. was a SPAC that signed a merger agreement on August 11, 2021 with Lexyl Travel Technologies (d/b/a HotelPlanner.com) contemplating an Up-C structure with Astrea as PubCo. The form-of Tax Receivable Agreement, filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the announcement 8-K, would have obligated Astrea to pay Pre-Closing Holders 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups on Common Unit exchanges, blocker-corporation tax attributes, and imputed-interest deductions. The form's preamble date and parties were blank placeholders. The parties mutually terminated the Merger Agreement on February 13, 2022 before any closing, the SPAC failed to identify a replacement target, and Astrea dissolved in December 2022. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
